title: How agents are transforming work
summary: A new OpenAI research paper shows how AI agents are transforming work, enabling longer, more complex tasks and expanding productivity across roles.
body: A new OpenAI research paper shows how AI agents are transforming work, enabling longer, more complex tasks and expanding productivity across roles.
summaryZh: OpenAI发布了一项新的研究论文，探讨AI智能体如何深刻改变现代工作方式。论文指出，智能体能够胜任更长时间、更复杂的任务，从而在各个职业角色中全面扩展生产力与应用边界。原始信息显示：A new OpenAI research paper shows how AI agents are transforming work, enabling longer, more complex tasks and expanding productivity across roles.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“How agents are transforming work”。其重要性主要体现在：OpenAI发布了关于AI智能体如何改变工作方式的新研究，展示了长周期复杂任务的生产力扩展。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
